title: Minority Salience and Criminal Justice Decisions
title_zh: 少数族裔显著性对刑事司法决策的影响
title_primary: 少数族裔显著性对刑事司法决策的影响
title_secondary: Minority Salience and Criminal Justice Decisions
authors: Kyra Hanemaaijer, Nadine Ketel, Olivier Marie
official: 官方在线 2025-06-17 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Decision-makers can exhibit biases when they overemphasize particularly salient features under limited attention. We exploit a sudden salience shock involving individuals of Moroccan descent to examine biases within the Dutch criminal justice system. The salience shock concerned the assassination of a defense attorney by organized crime and thus specifically targeted the justice system. Leveraging high-quality data covering arrest through appeal, we find no impact on police or prosecutor decisions but uncover a 72% increase in sentence lengths imposed by judges on salient individuals. Heterogeneity analyses suggest that judge experience with minority suspects can mitigate bias in these more discretionary decisions.
abstract_zh: 决策者在有限注意力下过度强调某些显著特征时，可能会表现出偏见。我们利用一起涉及摩洛哥裔个体的突发显著性冲击，考察荷兰刑事司法系统中的偏见。该显著性冲击涉及一名辩护律师被有组织犯罪暗杀，因此专门针对司法系统。利用涵盖从逮捕到上诉的高质量数据，我们发现警方或检察官决策未受影响，但法官对显著个体判处的刑期却增加了72%。异质性分析表明，法官与少数族裔嫌疑人的接触经验可缓解这些更具裁量性决策中的偏见。

title: Can Cash Transfers Save Lives? Evidence from a Large-Scale Experiment in Kenya
title_zh: 现金转移能否拯救生命？来自肯尼亚大规模实验的证据
title_primary: 现金转移能否拯救生命？来自肯尼亚大规模实验的证据
title_secondary: Can Cash Transfers Save Lives? Evidence from a Large-Scale Experiment in Kenya
authors: Michael Walker, Nick Shankar, Edward Miguel, Dennis Egger, Grady Killeen
official: 官方在线 2026-01-06 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: We estimate the impacts of large-scale unconditional cash transfers on child survival. One-time transfers of USD 1000 were provided to over 10,500 poor households across 653 randomized villages in Kenya. We collected census data on over 100,000 births, including on mortality and cause of death, and detailed data on household health behaviors. Unconditional cash transfers (accounting for spillovers) lead to 48% fewer infant deaths before age one and 45% fewer child deaths before age five. Detailed data on cause of death, transfer timing relative to birth, and the location of health facilities indicate that unconditional cash transfers and access to delivery care are complements in generating mortality reductions: the largest gains are estimated in neonatal and maternal causes of death largely preventable by appropriate obstetric care and among households living close to physician-staffed facilities and those who receive the transfer around the time of birth, and treatment leads to a large increase in hospital deliveries (by 45%). The infant and child mortality declines are concentrated among poorer households with below median assets or predicted consumption. The transfers also result in a substantial decline of 51% in female labor supply in the three months before and the three months after a birth, and improved child nutrition. Infant and child mortality largely revert to pre-program levels after cash transfers end. Despite not being the main aim of the original program, we show that unconditional cash transfers in this setting may be a cost-effective way to reduce infant and child deaths.
abstract_zh: 我们评估了大规模无条件现金转移对儿童生存的影响。在肯尼亚653个随机村庄中，向超过10,500户贫困家庭提供了一次性1000美元的转移支付。我们收集了超过100,000名出生人口的普查数据，包括死亡率和死因信息，以及家庭健康行为的详细数据。无条件现金转移（考虑溢出效应）导致一岁前婴儿死亡减少48%，五岁前儿童死亡减少45%。关于死因、转移支付相对于出生时间的时机以及卫生设施位置的详细数据表明，无条件现金转移与获得分娩护理在降低死亡率方面具有互补作用：最大的收益体现在新生儿和孕产妇死因上，这些死因大多可通过适当的产科护理加以预防，并且这些收益集中在居住在配备医生设施的附近以及在生产前后收到转移支付的家庭中；治疗还导致医院分娩大幅增加（增加45%）。婴儿和儿童死亡率的下降主要集中在资产或预测消费低于中位数的较贫困家庭中。转移支付还导致出生前后三个月内女性劳动力供给大幅下降51%，并改善了儿童营养状况。现金转移结束后，婴儿和儿童死亡率基本恢复到项目前水平。尽管这不是原项目的主要目标，我们表明在此背景下，无条件现金转移可能是降低婴儿和儿童死亡的一种成本效益高的方式。

title: Deconstructing and evaluating China’s land consolidation from the dual perspective of quantity and quality
title_zh: 数量与质量双重视角下中国土地整治的解构与评价
title_primary: 数量与质量双重视角下中国土地整治的解构与评价
title_secondary: Deconstructing and evaluating China’s land consolidation from the dual perspective of quantity and quality
authors: Yanchao Feng, Rui Wu, Zhenhua Zhang
official: 聚合元数据日期 2026-09-03 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: The spatiotemporal patterns of land consolidation in China have undergone profound reshaping, exerting significant impacts on socioeconomic development. Based on land use data from 2000 to 2024, this study analyzes the multi-scale spatiotemporal evolution and multidimensional effects of Chin’s land consolidation from the two dimensions of quantity and quality, specifically through cultivated land conversion area and cultivated land fragmentation. Significant spatial heterogeneity is identified. Four governance modes emerge: a "high-quantity-high-quality" synergistic improvement in the Northeast Plain; a coexistence of "high-quantity-low-quality" in the Yunnan-Guizhou Plateau; a "low-quantity-high-quality" optimization in the Huang-Huai-Hai Plain; and a "low-quantity-low-quality" lag in the Qinghai-Tibet Plateau. Markov-chain forecasts indicate that cultivated land conversion is mobile under policy intervention and spatial spillovers, whereas cultivated land fragmentation remains rigid and stable due to natural constraints and spatial lock-in. Using the High-Standard Farmland Construction Policy as a quasi-natural experiment, land consolidation is found to have significantly increased grain production capacity and agricultural net carbon sequestration, while its effects on land transfer exhibit marked regional heterogeneity. Stronger policy responses in yield improvement and carbon-sink gains are observed in central western regions and major grain-producing areas, whereas land-transfer markets in eastern China are more sensitive to policy shocks. The study provides systematic empirical evidence for improving territorial-spatial governance and offers China’s experience to global sustainable land management.
abstract_zh: 中国土地整治的时空格局经历了深刻重塑，对社会经济发展产生了显著影响。基于2000—2024年土地利用数据，本研究从数量与质量两个维度，即通过耕地转换面积与耕地破碎度，分析了中国土地整治的多尺度时空演变及其多维效应。研究发现显著的空间异质性。四种治理模式浮现：东北平原的“高数量—高质量”协同提升；云贵高原的“高数量—低质量”并存；黄淮海平原的“低数量—高质量”优化；以及青藏高原的“低数量—低质量”滞后。马尔可夫链预测表明，在政策干预与空间溢出作用下，耕地转换具有流动性，而耕地破碎度因自然约束与空间锁定效应而保持刚性与稳定。以高标准农田建设政策为准自然实验，研究发现土地整治显著提升了粮食生产能力与农业净碳汇，而其土地流转效应则呈现显著的区域异质性。中西部地区及粮食主产区在增产与碳汇增益方面表现出更强的政策响应，而东部地区土地流转市场对政策冲击更为敏感。本研究为完善国土空间治理提供了系统性经验证据，并为全球可持续土地管理贡献了中国经验。

title: Product Variety, Alcohol Purchases, and the Role of Excise Taxes
title_zh: 产品多样性、酒精购买行为与消费税的作用
title_primary: 产品多样性、酒精购买行为与消费税的作用
title_secondary: Product Variety, Alcohol Purchases, and the Role of Excise Taxes
authors: Aljoscha Janssen
official: 官方在线 2026-09-02 · 来源：RSS
abstract: This study explores how product variety affects alcohol purchasing in the U.S., using store-level and household scanner data. By analyzing households that relocate to areas with different product availability and controlling for destination-specific consumption patterns, I document a positive relationship between increased product variety and higher alcohol purchases. I complement the household-level evidence with an analysis of two state-specific policy changes, the 2012 Washington liquor deregulation and the 2009 Illinois excise tax increase, to document that policies that raise prices, particularly the Washington liquor deregulation, are also associated with expanded product variety, which may partially offset the intended reduction in consumption. The results have important implications for public health: policymakers should be aware that alcohol market reforms can inadvertently increase product assortment and thereby stimulate consumption, particularly among the heaviest purchasers.
abstract_zh: 本研究探讨了产品多样性如何影响美国的酒精购买行为，利用店铺层面及家庭层面的扫描数据进行分析。通过考察搬迁至产品供应情况不同地区的家庭，并控制目的地特有的消费模式，我发现产品多样性的增加与酒精购买量的上升之间存在正相关关系。为补充家庭层面的证据，我还分析了两个州级政策变动——2012年华盛顿州酒类销售放松管制及2009年伊利诺伊州消费税上调——结果表明，提高价格的政策，尤其是华盛顿州的酒类销售放松管制，同样伴随着产品多样性的扩大，这可能部分抵消了预期的消费减少效果。这些发现对公共健康具有重要启示：政策制定者应认识到，酒类市场改革可能无意中增加产品种类，进而刺激消费，尤其是在购买量最大的消费群体中。

title: Group-Sparse Matrix Factorization for Transfer Learning of Word Embeddings
title_zh: 词嵌入迁移学习的群稀疏矩阵分解
title_primary: 词嵌入迁移学习的群稀疏矩阵分解
title_secondary: Group-Sparse Matrix Factorization for Transfer Learning of Word Embeddings
authors: Kan Xu, Xuanyi Zhao, Hamsa Bastani, Osbert Bastani
official: 官方在线 2026-09-01 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Unstructured text provides decision makers with a rich data source in many domains, ranging from product reviews in retail to nursing notes in healthcare. To leverage this information, words are typically translated into word embeddings—vectors that encode the semantic relationships between words—through unsupervised learning algorithms such as matrix factorization. However, learning word embeddings from new domains with limited training data can be challenging because the meaning/usage may be different in the new domain; for example, the word “positive” typically has positive sentiment, but often has negative sentiment in medical notes because it may imply that a patient tested positive for a disease. In practice, we expect that only a small number of domain-specific words may have new meanings. We propose an intuitive two-stage estimator that exploits this structure via a group-sparse penalty to efficiently transfer learn domain-specific word embeddings by combining large-scale text corpora (such as Wikipedia) with limited domain-specific text data. We bound the generalization error of our transfer learning estimator, proving that it can achieve high accuracy with substantially less domain-specific data when only a small number of embeddings are altered between domains. Furthermore, we prove that all local minima identified by our nonconvex objective function are statistically indistinguishable from the global minimum under standard regularization conditions, implying that our estimator can be computed efficiently. Our results provide the first bounds on group-sparse matrix factorization, which may be of independent interest. We empirically evaluate our approach compared with state-of-the-art fine-tuning heuristics from natural language processing. This paper was accepted by Chung Piaw Teo, optimization. Funding: The authors gratefully acknowledge indispensable financial support from the Wharton Analytics Initiative and the Wharton Dean’s Fund. Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2022.01740 .
abstract_zh: 非结构化文本为决策者在众多领域提供了丰富的数据来源，从零售中的产品评论到医疗保健中的护理记录。为利用这些信息，词语通常通过无监督学习算法（如矩阵分解）转换为词嵌入——编码词语间语义关系的向量。然而，在新领域中使用有限训练数据学习词嵌入可能具有挑战性，因为新领域中词语的含义或用法可能有所不同；例如，“positive”一词通常带有积极情感，但在医疗记录中往往带有消极情感，因为它可能暗示患者检测出某种疾病阳性。在实践中，我们预期只有少数领域特定词语可能具有新含义。我们提出一种直观的两阶段估计器，利用这种结构，通过组稀疏惩罚，结合大规模文本语料库（如维基百科）与有限的领域特定文本数据，高效地迁移学习领域特定词嵌入。我们限定了迁移学习估计器的泛化误差，证明当仅少量嵌入在领域间发生变化时，它能以显著更少的领域特定数据实现高精度。此外，我们证明在标准正则化条件下，我们的非凸目标函数所识别的所有局部最小值在统计上与全局最小值不可区分，这意味着我们的估计器可以高效计算。我们的结果首次提供了组稀疏矩阵分解的界限，这可能具有独立的研究价值。我们通过实证评估，将我们的方法与自然语言处理中最先进的微调启发式方法进行比较。本文由Chung Piaw Teo（优化方向）接受。资助：作者衷心感谢沃顿分析计划及沃顿院长基金提供的不可或缺的财务支持。补充材料：在线附录和数据文件可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2022.01740获取。

title: Refugee immigration and natives’ fertility
title_zh: 难民移民与本地居民的生育率
title_primary: 难民移民与本地居民的生育率
title_secondary: Refugee immigration and natives’ fertility
authors: Aya Aboulhosn, Cevat Giray Aksoy, Berkay Ozcan
official: 官方在线 2026-08-14 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Research and policy debates on population aging typically assume that immigration matters only through immigrants’ own fertility and its impact on total population size, ignoring effects on natives’ fertility. We study this margin in the context of the large inflow of Syrian refugees into Türkiye after 2011. Using an instrumental-variables strategy, we provide evidence that greater local exposure to refugees increases native fertility. Drawing on complete birth histories from the Demographic and Health Surveys, we find that the response operates primarily through earlier entry into motherhood and is concentrated among younger women. The result holds across three independent datasets, including administrative birth registers, and is mirrored in women’s stated ideal number of children. Examining potential mechanisms, we find the evidence most consistent with improved household economic security and find no support for channels operating through housing costs or the use of paid childcare.
abstract_zh: 关于人口老龄化的研究与政策辩论通常假定移民仅通过其自身的生育率及其对总人口规模的影响发挥作用，而忽视了移民对本地人生育率的影响。我们在2011年后大量叙利亚难民涌入土耳其的背景下研究了这一边际效应。利用工具变量策略，我们提供了证据表明，难民在当地更大的暴露程度会增加本地人的生育率。基于人口与健康调查中的完整生育史数据，我们发现这一反应主要通过提前进入母亲身份实现，并集中于较年轻的女性群体。该结果在三个独立数据集中均成立，包括行政出生登记记录，并且与女性自述的理想子女数量相呼应。在考察潜在机制时，我们发现证据最支持家庭经济安全改善的解释，而未发现通过住房成本或使用有偿托儿服务发挥作用的渠道支持。

title: The exorbitant privilege of the periodic table
title_zh: 元素周期表的过高特权
title_primary: 元素周期表的过高特权
title_secondary: The exorbitant privilege of the periodic table
authors: Josh Kirk, Evgenia Passari, Hélène Rey
official: 官方在线 2026-08-13 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Trade in critical metals essential for electrification has become centred on China over the last three decades. This column introduces a new framework in which network centrality depends on strategic decisions and investments. It shows that the central position of China does not originate from resource endowments but from processing capacity. Furthermore, supply shocks to these metals raise inflation in both the US and EU, with larger and more persistent effects than shocks to oil and gas. To ensure supply-chain security, the EU needs to focus on adding processing capacity capable of responding when supply is restricted.
abstract_zh: 过去三十年间，对电气化至关重要的关键金属贸易已日益集中于中国。本文介绍了一个新框架，其中网络中心性取决于战略决策与投资。研究表明，中国的中心地位并非源于资源禀赋，而是来自加工能力。此外，这些金属的供应冲击会推高美国和欧盟的通胀，其影响比石油和天然气冲击更大且更持久。为确保供应链安全，欧盟需着力增加能够在供应受限时作出响应的加工能力。

title: Social Externalities and Economic Analysis
title_zh: 社会外部性与经济分析
title_primary: 社会外部性与经济分析
title_secondary: Social Externalities and Economic Analysis
authors: Marc Fleurbaey, Ravi Kanbur, Brody Viney
official: 官方在线 2020-08-18 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: This paper considers and assesses the concept of social externalities through human interdependence, in relation to the economic analysis of externalities in the tradition of Pigou and Arrow, including the analysis of the commons. It argues that there are limits to economic analysis. Our proposal is to enlarge the perspective and start thinking about a broader framework in which any pattern of influence of an agent or a group of agents over a third party, which is not mediated by any economic, social, or psychological mechanism guaranteeing the alignment of the marginal net private benefit with marginal net social benefit, can be attached the “externality” label and be scrutinized for the likely negative consequences that result from the divergence. These consequences may be significant given the many interactions between the social and economic realms, and the scope for spillovers and feedback loops to emerge. The paper also establishes a tentative and probably incomplete list of possible internalizing mechanisms for externalities under this broader framework, which includes: pricing and monetary incentives; altruism and solidarity; moral norms; reciprocity and mutual monitoring; centralized cooperative decision-making; and merger. There are clear reasons why the pricing mechanism is not appropriate in some cases. A more difficult question to answer is what factors determine which of the mechanisms is the appropriate one to rely on in a given sphere of relations and activities. The object of the paper is to encourage research and contributions from all the relevant disciplines of social sciences on the pervasive human interdependence that the notion of social externalities tries to capture.
abstract_zh: 本文通过人类相互依存的角度，探讨并评估了社会外部性的概念，并将其与庇古和阿罗传统下的外部性经济分析（包括公共资源分析）相联系。文章指出经济分析存在局限性。我们提议拓宽视角，开始构想一个更广泛的框架，在此框架内，任何个体或群体对第三方的影响模式，若未经由经济、社会或心理机制确保边际私人净收益与边际社会净收益的一致性，均可被贴上“外部性”标签，并对其因偏离而产生的潜在负面后果进行审视。鉴于社会与经济领域间的众多互动，以及溢出效应和反馈循环出现的可能性，这些后果可能相当显著。本文还初步建立了一份可能不完整的内化机制清单，适用于这一更广泛框架下的外部性，包括：定价与货币激励；利他主义与团结；道德规范；互惠与相互监督；集中合作决策；以及合并。存在明确理由说明为何在某些情况下定价机制并不适用。一个更难回答的问题是，在特定的关系与活动领域中，哪些因素决定了应依赖哪种机制。本文旨在鼓励社会科学各相关学科就社会外部性概念试图捕捉的普遍人类相互依存性展开研究并作出贡献。

title: Wide or Narrow? Competition and Scope in Financial Intermediation
title_zh: 宽还是窄？金融中介中的竞争与范围
title_primary: 宽还是窄？金融中介中的竞争与范围
title_secondary: Wide or Narrow? Competition and Scope in Financial Intermediation
authors: Matteo Benetton, Greg Buchak, Claudia Robles-Garcia
official: 官方在线 2022-07-23 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: We study the role of scope in financial intermediation. Using new credit registry data on US firms, we show that in the market for small business lending, multi-product banks benefit from economies of scope across products but exploit their market power to steer firms into more profitable, less regulated products. To quantify these forces and the welfare implications of scope, we develop and estimate an equilibrium model of firm credit provision where banks compete with more specialized non-bank financial intermediaries. In counterfactual simulations, we show that market power and bank steering increase prices and reduce welfare for small firms. These losses, however, are less than the gains from cost synergies. We also simulate equilibrium effects of alternative banking regulations. Our results highlight the need for regulation to recognize the multi-product nature of financial intermediaries.
abstract_zh: 我们研究了范围在经济中介中的作用。利用美国企业的新信贷登记数据，我们表明，在小企业贷款市场中，多产品银行从跨产品的范围经济中获益，但利用其市场力量将企业引导至利润更高、监管较少的产品。为了量化这些力量及范围对福利的影响，我们开发并估计了一个企业信贷供给的均衡模型，其中银行与更专业化的非银行金融中介竞争。在反事实模拟中，我们表明，市场力量和银行引导提高了价格并减少了小企业的福利。然而，这些损失小于成本协同效应带来的收益。我们还模拟了替代性银行监管的均衡效应。我们的结果强调了监管需认识到金融中介多产品特性的必要性。

title: Opioids and Post-COVID Labor-Force Participation
title_zh: opioids与后疫情时期劳动力参与率
title_primary: opioids与后疫情时期劳动力参与率
title_secondary: Opioids and Post-COVID Labor-Force Participation
authors: Francesco Chiocchio, Jeremy Greenwood, Nezih Guner, Karen Kopecky, Richard Blundell 等
official: 官方在线 2025-07-05 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: At the onset of COVID-19, U.S. labor-force participation fell by about 3 percentage points and remained below pre-pandemic levels three years later. Recovery was slower in states hit harder by the pre-pandemic opioid crisis, measured by age-adjusted overdose death rates. An event study shows that a one-standard-deviation increase in pre-COVID opioid deaths led to a 0.9 percentage point drop in post-COVID labor participation. This effect wasn’t due to differences in overall health across states and was stronger among those without a college degree. In high-opioid states, slower recovery was linked to more people leaving the workforce due to disability.
abstract_zh: 在COVID-19疫情初期，美国劳动力参与率下降了约3个百分点，并在三年后仍低于疫情前水平。以年龄调整后的药物过量死亡率衡量，疫情前阿片类药物危机更为严重的州，其复苏速度更为缓慢。事件研究显示，疫情前阿片类药物死亡人数每增加一个标准差，疫情后劳动力参与率下降0.9个百分点。这一效应并非源于各州整体健康状况的差异，且在未受过大学教育的人群中更为显著。在高阿片类药物使用州，复苏缓慢与更多人因残疾而退出劳动力市场有关。

abstract: Reduced-form bequest motives are routinely assumed to exhibit decreasing absolute risk aversion (DARA). I show this is consistent with an underlying altruistic primitive: when descendant risk is unrealised at the bequest choice date, DARA of the warm-glow preference is inherited from the descendant’s continuation value under both multiplicative and additive risk, without parametric restriction. Yet the two canonical specifications differ in what is preserved beyond DARA. Multiplicative risk yields a shifter-weight decomposition and preserves CRRA form; additive income risk—the relevant case for dynastic precautionary savings—preserves DARA but not functional form. • Warm-glow bequest motives inherit DARA from the descendant’s continuation value. • Holds under additive and multiplicative risk without parametric restriction. • Differences across calibrated studies need not reflect altruism strength. • Multiplicative risk preserves CRRA functional form; additive income risk does not. • Under additive risk, functional form is not disciplined by the altruistic primitive.
abstract_zh: 简化形式的遗赠动机通常被假定表现出递减绝对风险厌恶（DARA）。我证明这与潜在的利他主义原始设定相一致：当后代风险在遗赠选择日期尚未实现时，暖光偏好的DARA特性是从后代的延续价值中继承而来的，无论是在乘法风险还是加法风险下，均无需参数限制。然而，两种典型设定在DARA之外所保留的特性上存在差异。乘法风险产生了一种移位权重分解，并保留了CRRA形式；加法收入风险——与王朝预防性储蓄相关的情形——保留了DARA但未保留函数形式。• 暖光遗赠动机从后代的延续价值中继承DARA。• 在加法和乘法风险下均成立，无需参数限制。• 校准研究间的差异未必反映利他主义强度。• 乘法风险保留CRRA函数形式；加法收入风险则不保留。• 在加法风险下，函数形式不受利他主义原始设定的约束。

abstract: I document that the right tail of the firm size distribution systematically thickens with economic development. To rationalize this fact, I develop a parsimonious idea search model in which both aggregate growth and the firm size distribution are endogenously determined. The model features an asymptotic balanced growth path along which Gibrat's law holds at each date, and the right tail of the firm size distribution thickens monotonically toward Zipf's law. The model also implies that policies favoring large firms can improve welfare by better utilizing the diffusion externalities arising from idea search.
abstract_zh: 本文发现，企业规模分布的右尾随经济发展系统性增厚。为解释这一事实，我构建了一个简约的思想搜寻模型，其中总量增长与企业规模分布均为内生决定。该模型具有渐进平衡增长路径特征，在此路径上各期均满足吉布拉定律，且企业规模分布的右尾单调增厚直至趋近齐普夫定律。模型还表明，偏好大企业的政策可通过更充分利用思想搜寻产生的扩散外部性来提升社会福利。

official: 官方在线 1987-02-01 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: This paper discusses the best way to formulate and estimate a dynamic econometric model when interest focuses mainly upon its long-run properties. Using results derived for the more general context of transformed regression models, it is shown how point estimates and the standard errors of long-run multipliers and long-run structural coefficients can be obtained using standard estimation methods. It is argued that such formulations are preferable to other specifications such as the error correction model. If the explanatory variables that enter the long-run solution are trend-stationary then it is found that no harm is done to the asymptotic properties of the long-run coefficients by omitting short-run dynamics entirely, though this is not recommended in practice. The results of this paper are related to the concept of co-integration and to the work of Engle and Granger. Finally, a new methodology for the construction of dynamic models is proposed.
abstract_zh: 本文探讨了当研究重点主要集中于长期性质时，如何最优地构建和估计动态计量经济模型。基于从更广义的变换回归模型推导出的结论，本文展示了如何利用标准估计方法获得长期乘数和长期结构系数的点估计及其标准误。研究认为，此类模型设定优于误差修正模型等其他形式。若进入长期解的解释变量为趋势平稳序列，则完全忽略短期动态不会影响长期系数估计的渐近性质，但实践中不推荐此做法。本文结论与协整概念及Engle和Granger的研究相关联。最后，本文提出了一种构建动态模型的新方法论。

abstract: We study the economic effects of transfers to local governments using a reform of the Finnish municipal grant system as a source of exogenous variation. We find that higher grants lead to lower municipal taxes and fees, higher public spending and improved budget balance. These changes in local fiscal policy lead to an increase in private sector jobs. Our estimates imply a cost per job of e33,000. The increase in jobs is paired with a reduction in commuting to other municipalities. The effect on migration seems small, suggesting grants bring local benefits without drastically affecting where households choose to live.
abstract_zh: 我们利用芬兰市政拨款制度改革作为外生变动的来源，研究了对地方政府转移支付的经济效应。研究发现，更高的拨款导致市政税费降低、公共支出增加以及预算平衡改善。这些地方财政政策的变化带来了私营部门就业岗位的增加。我们的估算显示，每个就业岗位的成本为33,000欧元。就业增长的同时，通勤至其他市镇的人数有所减少。对迁移的影响似乎较小，这表明拨款在带来地方利益的同时，并未显著改变家庭居住地的选择。

abstract: This paper studies the effects of income taxation on entrepreneurship, empirically and in a structural macro model with entrepreneurial choice. Combining state-level tax data with household and firm data we document that higher and more progressive taxation has a strong negative impact on entrepreneurial activity across time and space. To explain this relationship and to evaluate the impact of taxation on output and welfare, we develop a life cycle, incomplete markets model of the labor market with entrepreneurial choice. The model generates elasticities of entrepreneurship to taxation that are similar to those found in the empirical analysis.
abstract_zh: 本文通过实证研究与包含创业选择的结构性宏观模型，探讨了所得税对创业活动的影响。结合州级税收数据与家庭及企业数据，我们证实：在跨时间与跨空间维度上，更高且更具累进性的税收对创业活动具有显著的负面效应。为解释这一关系并评估税收对产出与福利的影响，我们构建了一个包含创业选择的劳动力市场生命周期不完全市场模型。该模型生成的创业活动对税收的弹性系数与实证分析结果高度吻合。

abstract: We leverage the high degree of worker mobility across production lines in a large Indian manufacturer to estimate the sorting of workers to managers, using data on daily worker productivity. We find negative assortative matching (NAM): better workers tend to be matched with worse managers. Estimates of the production technology, however, reveal that productivity would increase by up to 4% under positive sorting. Exploiting a survey of managers and data on orders from multinational brands, we document that NAM arises, at least partly, because maintaining valuable relationships with buyers provides strong incentives to avoid delays on any given production line.
abstract_zh: 我们利用印度一家大型制造商生产线上工人高度流动的特点，结合工人日生产率数据，估算了工人与管理者的匹配模式。研究发现存在负向分类匹配（NAM）：表现更优的工人往往与能力较弱的管理者配对。然而，对生产技术的估算表明，若实现正向分类匹配，生产率最高可提升4%。通过分析管理者调查数据及跨国品牌订单信息，我们证实负向分类匹配的产生至少部分源于以下机制：维护与买方的价值关系会形成强烈激励，促使管理者避免任何生产线出现延误。

title_zh: 企业总储蓄、经济不确定性与未来股票收益

abstract: I document robust U.S. and international evidence that aggregate corporate cash savings negatively forecast future excess market returns, with economic uncertainty an important driver of this relation. In a calibrated neoclassical dynamic model featuring precautionary savings, I show that fixed financing costs, firm exit, and an uncertainty-driven time-varying price of risk are crucial to replicating this return predictability. The model further implies that the well-known positive return predictive power of aggregate accruals is largely attributable to aggregate cash savings, and the data support this implication.
abstract_zh: 我记录了美国及国际上的有力证据，表明总体企业现金储蓄对未来超额市场回报具有负向预测作用，其中经济不确定性是这一关系的重要驱动因素。在一个包含预防性储蓄的校准新古典动态模型中，我展示了固定融资成本、企业退出以及由不确定性驱动的时变风险价格，对于复现这种回报可预测性至关重要。该模型进一步暗示，总体应计项目众所周知的正面回报预测能力在很大程度上归因于总体现金储蓄，而数据支持了这一推论。

title_secondary: Beyond health: a systematic review of cross-sector economic implications of school-based mental health programmes in Europe
authors: Wendel, Flora, Walbaum, Magdalena, Finger, Celina, Brettschneider, Christian, Jung-Sievers, Caroline 等
official: 官方在线 2026-06-25 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Objective To assess the economic evidence on school-based prevention and mental health promotion interventions, focusing on costs and outcomes across key societal sectors, including healthcare, education, social care, criminal justice, as well as in productivity and individual expenses. Design A systematic review with narrative synthesis was conducted following the Synthesis Without Meta-analysis approach, including an assessment of monetised outcomes across all sectors and an additional analysis of non-monetised outcomes in the education sector. Study quality was appraised using Consolidated Health Economic Evaluation Reporting Standards (CHEERS) and Consensus Health Economic Criteria (CHEC). Data sources Medline, Embase, PsycINFO, Econlit, ERIC and Scopus. Eligibility criteria for selecting studies Economic evaluations of school-based prevention or mental health promotion interventions for children or adolescents in Europe that report outcomes across healthcare and other societal sectors. Results 20 studies were included, comprising different types of economic evaluations as well as trial-based and model-based evaluations. Based on the primary analyses reported in the studies, which consider costs and benefits across multiple societal sectors, most evaluations suggested favourable economic outcomes. Benefits exceeded costs in four out of five (80%) cost–benefit analyses (average cost–benefit ratio of 5.14). Half of the cost-effectiveness analyses found that interventions were more effective but also more costly than the comparator while two interventions were both more effective and less costly. In cost–utility analyses, 9 out of 10 (90%) fell below commonly used thresholds for good value for money. Reported outcomes covered healthcare, education, social care, criminal justice sectors, as well as productivity and individual expenses. Pronounced cost savings from included interventions were observed in productivity and healthcare, with improvements also observed in non-monetised education outcomes. Study quality was mixed. Conclusions School-based mental health interventions yield cross-sectoral economic benefits and, in many cases, societal returns on investment, in both the short and longer term, by influencing key determinants of health and well-being across multiple sectors.
abstract_zh: 目的 评估基于学校的预防与心理健康促进干预措施的经济学证据，重点关注关键社会部门（包括医疗、教育、社会照护、刑事司法）以及生产力和个人支出中的成本与结果。设计 采用无荟萃分析的综合方法进行系统综述与叙述性综合，包括对所有部门的货币化结果进行评估，并对教育部门的非货币化结果进行额外分析。研究质量采用《卫生经济学评价报告标准》（CHEERS）和《卫生经济学评价共识标准》（CHEC）进行评估。数据来源 Medline、Embase、PsycINFO、Econlit、ERIC 和 Scopus。研究选择标准 针对欧洲儿童或青少年开展的基于学校的预防或心理健康促进干预措施的经济学评价，且报告涉及医疗及其他社会部门的结果。结果 共纳入20项研究，涵盖不同类型的经济学评价，包括基于试验和基于模型的评价。基于研究报告的主要分析（考虑多个社会部门的成本与收益），大多数评价显示有利的经济结果。在五项成本-收益分析中，四项（80%）显示收益超过成本（平均成本-收益比为5.14）。半数成本-效果分析发现干预措施比对照措施更有效但成本更高，而两项干预措施既更有效又成本更低。在成本-效用分析中，90%（10项中的9项）低于常用的物有所值阈值。报告的结果涵盖医疗、教育、社会照护、刑事司法部门，以及生产力和个人支出。纳入的干预措施在生产力与医疗领域观察到显著的成本节约，同时在非货币化的教育结果方面也观察到改善。研究质量参差不齐。结论 基于学校的心理健康干预措施通过影响多个部门中健康与福祉的关键决定因素，在短期和长期内均能产生跨部门的经济效益，并在许多情况下带来社会投资回报。

official: 官方在线 2026-06-25 · 来源：RSS
abstract: This article examines the welfare consequences of a trade association in an exporting country on consumers in destination countries. We estimate a structural model of the Chilean Salmon exporting industry that endogenizes firms' pricing and export decisions. Our results show that the trade association has a positive effect on consumer utility and involves higher marginal costs of production, consistent with higher quality products. Reduced form analysis estimates price effects associated with trade association membership of 3 to 8 percent. Our counterfactual analysis reveals that eliminating the trade association would reduce consumer welfare by 1.7 billion USD in destination countries.
abstract_zh: 本文研究了出口国行业协会对目的地国家消费者的福利影响。我们构建了智利鲑鱼出口行业的结构模型，将企业的定价与出口决策内生化。研究结果表明，该行业协会对消费者效用具有正向影响，同时伴随着更高的边际生产成本，这与产品质量提升的结论一致。简化形式分析估计，行业协会成员身份带来的价格效应为3%至8%。反事实分析显示，若取消该行业协会，目的地国家的消费者福利将减少17亿美元。

abstract_zh: 2026年3月燃油价格急剧上涨，为澳大利亚可持续出行行为转变创造了潜在窗口。然而，哪些人群具备改变出行方式的条件仍鲜为人知。一项于2026年4月开展的针对2177名澳大利亚成年人的全国代表性在线调查，捕捉了危机前的出行行为、出行方式转变考量及支持持续改变的条件。可解释机器学习（XGBoost、SHAP、监督k-means聚类）识别出对步行、骑行、电动自行车及公共交通具有适应性的亚群。四分之三的受访者已改变或考虑改变出行行为。步行是最常采用的新出行方式（20%），而规避出行是最常见的适应行为（41%）。经济困难与年轻化是适应性的主导预测因子。监督聚类揭示了三种反复出现的典型群体——经济压力大的年轻人、在职城市专业人士及缺乏服务覆盖的偏远地区居民。实现公平的可持续出行成果，需要交通系统为所有人群提供可负担且安全的替代方案。

title: How artificial intelligence tokens interact with the energy sector: a novel perspective
title_zh: 人工智能代币与能源行业的互动：一个新视角
title_primary: 人工智能代币与能源行业的互动：一个新视角

authors: Naif Alsagr, Ahmed Bouteska
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-06-14 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: This study employs a time-varying parameter vector autoregressive (TVP-VAR) model to extend the joint connectivity model and investigate the correlation between artificial intelligence (AI) tokens and the energy market. The analysis covers the period from 1 November 2019, to 20 May 2024, and includes eight mainstream AI tokens (such as Cortex, Fetch.ai, and SingularityNET) as well as energy assets including oil, natural gas, and biofuels. The findings reveal a significant correlation between AI tokens and energy assets, with the strength of this correlation exhibiting asymmetric characteristics. This study provides key insights for investors and policymakers to gain a deeper understanding of the evolving interplay between AI-driven digital assets and the energy sector.
abstract_zh: 本研究采用时变参数向量自回归（TVP-VAR）模型，扩展联合连通性模型，以探讨人工智能（AI）代币与能源市场之间的关联性。分析覆盖自2019年11月1日至2024年5月20日期间，纳入八种主流AI代币（如Cortex、Fetch.ai和SingularityNET）以及包括石油、天然气和生物燃料在内的能源资产。研究结果显示，AI代币与能源资产之间存在显著相关性，且这种相关性的强度表现出非对称特征。本研究为投资者和政策制定者提供了关键见解，以更深入地理解AI驱动的数字资产与能源部门之间不断演变的相互作用。

title: Physicians as Persuaders: Evidence from Hospitals in China
title_zh: 医生作为说服者：来自中国医院的证据
title_primary: 医生作为说服者：来自中国医院的证据
title_secondary: Physicians as Persuaders: Evidence from Hospitals in China
authors: Jia Xiang
official: 官方在线 2026-05-12 · 来源：RSS
abstract: I estimate a Bayesian persuasion model to examine how financial incentives and asymmetric information shape physician–patient interactions. This approach offers new insights into the role of insurance. First, the model predicts that patients' coinsurance moderates physicians' responsiveness to increases in service fees. This prediction is supported by a difference-in-differences analysis using Chinese health insurance claims data with random variation in physicians' reimbursement and patients' coinsurance rates. Second, the model implies that lower coinsurance rates reduce both patient price elasticity and skepticism, increasing the likelihood of physicians misdirecting patients toward unnecessary treatments. Using structural model estimates, I show that for a diagnosis where surgical treatment is discretionary, nearly half of the patients who received surgery would not have done so were they fully informed. Such misdirection from physicians is greater when coinsurance rates decrease, highlighting a new inefficiency channel beyond moral hazard. I decompose the effect of lowering coinsurance into moral hazard and the novel greater misdirection effect. Counterfactual analysis shows that, while patients benefit from lower out-of-pocket costs, greater misdirection nearly offsets these welfare gains.
abstract_zh: 我估计了一个贝叶斯说服模型，以考察经济激励和信息不对称如何塑造医患互动。这一方法为理解保险的作用提供了新视角。首先，模型预测患者的共付比例会调节医生对服务费用增加的响应程度。这一预测得到了基于中国健康保险索赔数据的双重差分分析的支持，该数据中医生报销比例和患者共付比例存在随机变动。其次，模型暗示较低的共付比例会降低患者的价格敏感性和怀疑程度，从而增加医生将患者误导至不必要治疗的可能性。利用结构模型估计，我表明对于手术属于可选择性治疗的诊断，近半数接受手术的患者若完全知情则不会选择手术。当共付比例下降时，医生的此类误导行为更为严重，这凸显了道德风险之外的一个新的效率损失渠道。我将降低共付比例的影响分解为道德风险和新的更大误导效应。反事实分析显示，尽管患者从较低的自付费用中获益，但更大的误导效应几乎抵消了这些福利收益。

title: Macroeconomic forecasting during recessions and expansions in the US and the euro area
title_zh: 美国与欧元区经济衰退与扩张时期的宏观经济预测
title_primary: 美国与欧元区经济衰退与扩张时期的宏观经济预测
title_secondary: Macroeconomic forecasting during recessions and expansions in the US and the euro area
authors: Jan Čapek, Jakub Chalmovianský, Vlastimil Reichel
official: 官方在线 2026-05-05 · 来源：RSS
abstract: This study systematically evaluates forecasting performance of 11 Dynamic Stochastic General Equilibrium (DSGE) and 2 Bayesian Vector Autoregression (BVAR) models during recessions and expansions in the US and the euro area. Results show that no single model dominates: parsimonious models perform well in stable periods and at short horizons, while richer DSGE specifications with financial frictions, flexible inflation targeting, or labor market dynamics improve forecasts during recessions. BVARs excel in interest rate forecasting, especially in expansions. Crisis‐specific extensions, such as COVID‐related shocks, yield temporary gains. Forecast accuracy depends on the economic state, variable, horizon, and evaluation metric, underscoring the need for a diversified, context‐dependent modeling toolkit.
abstract_zh: 本研究系统评估了11种动态随机一般均衡（DSGE）模型与2种贝叶斯向量自回归（BVAR）模型在美国和欧元区经济衰退与扩张期间的预测表现。结果表明，不存在单一主导模型：简约型模型在稳定时期及短期预测中表现良好，而包含金融摩擦、灵活通胀目标或劳动力市场动态的复杂DSGE模型则能改善衰退期的预测精度。BVAR模型在利率预测方面表现突出，尤其在扩张期。针对特定危机的扩展（如新冠疫情相关冲击）可带来短期预测增益。预测准确性取决于经济状态、变量类型、预测期限及评估指标，这凸显了构建多元化、情境依赖型建模工具集的必要性。

title: Competing for influence in networks through strategic targeting
title_zh: 通过策略性目标选择在网络中竞争影响力
title_primary: 通过策略性目标选择在网络中竞争影响力
title_secondary: Competing for influence in networks through strategic targeting
authors: Margherita Comola, Agnieszka Rusinowska, Marie Claire Villeval
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-04-12 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: We experimentally investigate targeting decisions in a setting where a human player competes for influence in a network against a computerized opponent with opposing views, whose targeting choice is revealed before the player acts. By varying network structure, opponent influence, and nodes opinion heterogeneity, we find that players typically adopt best-response strategies based on relative influence. However, they sometimes deviate – for example, by erroneously targeting central nodes or by avoiding the opponent’s target. Targeting is also affected by affinity and opposition biases, the strength of which depends on the initial opinion distribution. Targeting the center, avoiding the competitor’s target, or selecting nodes based on their initial opinions when these are not best responses generates significant efficiency losses.
abstract_zh: 我们通过实验研究了一个情境下的目标选择决策，其中人类玩家与持有相反观点的计算机化对手在网络中争夺影响力，而对手的目标选择在玩家行动前已被揭示。通过改变网络结构、对手影响力及节点观点异质性，我们发现玩家通常基于相对影响力采取最佳响应策略。然而，他们有时会偏离这一策略——例如，错误地瞄准中心节点或避开对手的目标。目标选择还受到亲和性与对立偏见的影响，其强度取决于初始观点分布。当瞄准中心、避开竞争者目标或依据初始观点选择节点并非最佳响应时，这些行为会导致显著的效率损失。

title: Academic human capital in European countries and regions, 1200–1793
title_zh: 欧洲国家与地区的学术人力资本（1200–1793）
title_primary: 欧洲国家与地区的学术人力资本（1200–1793）
title_secondary: Academic human capital in European countries and regions, 1200–1793
authors: Matthew Curtis, David de la Croix, Filippo Manfredini, Mara Vitale
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-04-08 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: We present new annual time-series data on academic human capital across Europe from 1200 to 1793, constructed by aggregating individual-level measures at three geographic scales: cities, present-day countries (as of 2025), and historically informed macro-regions. Individual human capital is derived from a composite index of publication outcomes, based on data from the Repertorium Eruditorum Totius Europae (RETE) database. The macro-regional classifications are designed to reflect historically coherent entities, offering a more relevant perspective than modern national boundaries. This framework allows us to document key patterns, including the Little Divergence in academic human capital between Northern and Southern Europe, the effect of the Black Death and the Thirty Years’ War on academic human capital, the respective contributions of academies and universities, regional inequality across Catholic and Protestant areas of the Holy Roman Empire, and the distinctiveness of the Scottish Enlightenment.
abstract_zh: 我们提供了欧洲1200年至1793年间学术人力资本的新的年度时间序列数据，这些数据通过在城市、现代国家（截至2025年）和历史宏观区域三个地理尺度上汇总个体层面的测量值构建而成。个体人力资本来源于基于《欧洲学者名录》（RETE）数据库的出版成果综合指数。宏观区域分类旨在反映历史上连贯的实体，比现代国家边界提供了更相关的视角。这一框架使我们能够记录关键模式，包括北欧与南欧之间学术人力资本的“小分流”、黑死病和三十年战争对学术人力资本的影响、学院与大学各自的贡献、神圣罗马帝国内天主教与新教地区的区域不平等，以及苏格兰启蒙运动的独特性。

title: A flexible model of food security: Estimation and implications for prediction
title_zh: 粮食安全的灵活模型：估计及其对预测的启示
title_primary: 粮食安全的灵活模型：估计及其对预测的启示
title_secondary: A flexible model of food security: Estimation and implications for prediction
authors: Will Davis, José Xilau, Rusty Tchernis, Christian Gregory
official: 官方在线 2026-04-02 · 来源：RSS
abstract: We propose a novel Bayesian Graded Response Model (BGRM) for measuring household-level food security and other latent traits. The BGRM produces continuous food security estimates along with household-level measures of estimation uncertainty. Unlike the USDA's official model, the BGRM accommodates both binary and ordered polytomous items. We further extend the model to allow for any combination of binary, ordered polytomous, and even continuous variables. To demonstrate the model's features, we estimate the BGRM using responses to the 10 adult core Food Security Module questions from the 2017–2018 National Health and Nutrition Examination Survey (NHANES). Results show non-trivial uncertainty in household-level food security estimates and overlap across USDA-defined food security categories. As a robustness check, we estimate the model with Current Population Survey data, finding qualitatively similar results. We illustrate an application of the continuous food security estimates by calculating Foster, Greer, and Thorbecke indices which capture the prevalence, depth, and severity of food insecurity. To demonstrate flexibility in variable selection, we also include a continuous variable, household-level monthly food spending, capturing both economic access and experiential food security information in a single latent construct. The adaptability of the BGRM positions it as a versatile tool for measuring food security and related latent traits, particularly when measures of uncertainty or a mix of different variable types are required. While the empirical application illustrates model capabilities, the primary contribution of the study is methodological.
abstract_zh: 我们提出了一种新颖的贝叶斯分级响应模型（BGRM），用于衡量家庭层面的粮食安全及其他潜在特质。BGRM能够生成连续的粮食安全估计值，并提供家庭层面的估计不确定性度量。与美国农业部的官方模型不同，BGRM同时适用于二元和有序多分类项目。我们进一步扩展该模型，使其能够处理二元、有序多分类乃至连续变量的任意组合。为展示模型特性，我们利用2017-2018年全国健康与营养调查（NHANES）中10个成人核心粮食安全模块问题的回答来估计BGRM。结果显示，家庭层面粮食安全估计存在显著的不确定性，且美国农业部定义的粮食安全类别之间存在重叠。作为稳健性检验，我们使用当前人口调查数据估计该模型，发现结果在性质上相似。我们通过计算Foster、Greer和Thorbecke指数来展示连续粮食安全估计的应用，这些指数捕捉了粮食不安全的普遍性、深度和严重程度。为展示变量选择的灵活性，我们还将家庭月度食品支出这一连续变量纳入模型，在单一潜在构念中同时捕捉经济获取和体验性粮食安全信息。BGRM的适应性使其成为衡量粮食安全及相关潜在特质的多功能工具，尤其是在需要不确定性度量或混合不同类型变量的情况下。尽管实证应用展示了模型的能力，但本研究的主要贡献在于方法论层面。

title: Financial Shocks, Productivity, and Prices
title_zh: 金融冲击、生产率与价格
title_primary: 金融冲击、生产率与价格
title_secondary: Financial Shocks, Productivity, and Prices
authors: Simone Lenzu, David Rivers, Joris Tielens, Shi Hu
official: 官方在线 2026-02-25 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: We study the interconnection between the productivity and pricing effects of financial shocks. Combining administrative records on firm-level output prices and quantities with quasi-experimental variation in credit supply, we show that a tightening of credit conditions has a persistent, yet delayed, negative effect on firms’ long-run physical productivity growth (TFPQ) but also induces firms to change their pricing policies. Commonly used revenue-based productivity measures (TFPR) — which conflate price and productivity — offer biased predictions regarding the consequences of financial shocks for firms’ productivity growth, underestimating the long-run elasticity of physical productivity to credit supply by half. We also show that the pricing adjustments themselves have productivity implications. Firms use low pricing as a source of internal financing, allowing them to avoid cutting expenditures on productivity-enhancing activities, thereby softening the impact of financial shocks. We incorporate these forces into a quantitative model of firm dynamics to quantify the importance of productivity and pricing dynamics (and their interplay) in driving the scarring effects of financial crises on aggregate productivity and welfare.
abstract_zh: 我们研究了金融冲击对生产率与定价效应之间的相互关联。通过结合企业层面产出价格与数量的行政记录，以及信贷供给的准实验性变化，我们发现信贷条件收紧对企业长期实物生产率增长（TFPQ）具有持久但滞后的负面影响，同时也会促使企业调整其定价策略。常用的基于收入的生产率指标（TFPR）——混淆了价格与生产率——在预测金融冲击对企业生产率增长的影响时存在偏差，将实物生产率对信贷供给的长期弹性低估了一半。我们还发现，定价调整本身对生产率具有影响。企业将低定价作为内部融资来源，从而避免削减对生产率提升活动的支出，进而缓解金融冲击的影响。我们将这些机制纳入一个企业动态定量模型，以量化生产率与定价动态（及其相互作用）在驱动金融危机对总生产率和福利的疤痕效应中的重要性。
